test_case.test_name: Linux R525 driver initialization and nvidia-smi
test_case.purpose: Install the approved R525 build, reboot and prove all mapped GPUs initialize with consistent kernel/userspace versions.
test_case.test_command: Record baseline; verify R525 package; install through one approved ownership model; reboot once; compare proc and nvidia-smi versions, modules, GPU inventory and logs.
test_case.expected_result: Approved R525 build is active consistently, all GPUs enumerate and no new driver/GPU error exists.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: R470, moving latest, version-only or installer exit cannot satisfy R525 initialization.
test_case.recovery: Restore known-good driver through approved channel/OOB and verify baseline.
